questions.q: Why did the son decide to leave home?
o: He wanted to learn a trade
He wanted to be a soldier
questions.e: “I'm going into the world to learn a trade.”

questions.q: Who turned out to be the master in green clothes?
What did the old woman advise the boy to say to the master?
o: That the master was the best in the world

questions.q: How long did the boy stay with the devil?
What did the son turn into at the first fair?
questions.e: The boy turned into a horse like no other.

questions.q: What instruction did the son give his father for selling the horse?
o: Not to sell the horse at all
Take the money but not hand over the bridle — strike it on the ground
Give the bridle to the buyer
questions.e: “Don't give the bridle — strike it on the ground.”

questions.q: What did the son turn into while the devil chased him?
o: A pigeon, then a ring on the emperor's daughter's hand
questions.e: A pigeon, then a ring on the princess's hand.
